D: After the war, an Australian farmer travels to Turkey to find the sons he lost at Gallipoli.
P: Serve the main when Joshua arrives at Ayshe's hotel in Istanbul.
S: Ayshe's hotel meze with smoky eggplant
Smoky eggplant dip, hummus, olives, feta and sumac flatbread

Smoky charred eggplant dip with tahini and garlic, hummus, olives, feta and warm flatbread brushed with sumac oil. Char 2 eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, until collapsed. Cool, scoop out the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 crushed garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Spoon into a bowl with olive oil and parsley. Brush 4 flatbreads with oil mixed with 1 tsp sumac and grill 1 minute a side. Serve with 200g hummus, 150g olives and 150g feta.
Red lentil soup, flatbread. Ayshe says to bribe a fisherman

Soften the onion and carrot in half the butter for 6 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste and cumin. Add the lentils and stock and simmer 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart. Blend smooth and season. Melt the rest of the butter with the paprika and drizzle over each bowl. Serve with lemon wedges and warm flatbread.
M: Spiced lamb skewers on flatbread with garlic yoghurt and chilli butter

Chargrilled lamb kofte spiced with cumin and sumac, on warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and onion salad and a drizzle of chilli butter. Mix 600g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp sumac, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove. Toss 3 diced tomatoes and 1 sliced red onion with parsley and lemon. Melt 30g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes. Serve on warm flatbread with yoghurt, salad and chilli butter.
Chicken pilaf. Joshua follows his dream to the windmill
Chicken thigh browned with onion and cinnamon, cooked with long grain rice in stock, finished with toasted almonds, currants and dill.
W: Layered filo with pistachio and walnut, soaked in honey syrup

Crisp layers of buttered filo filled with pistachios, walnuts and cinnamon, soaked in honey and lemon syrup and cut into diamonds. Blitz 150g pistachios and 100g walnuts with 1 tsp cinnamon until finely chopped. Brush a 20 x 30cm tin with melted butter. Layer 6 sheets filo, brushing each with butter from 150g, scatter with half the nuts, add 4 more buttered sheets, the rest of the nuts and a final 6 sheets. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Simmer 200g sugar, 150ml water, 3 tbsp honey and lemon juice for 5 minutes and pour over the hot baklava.
Oat and golden syrup. Joshua explains cricket on the train

Golden oat, coconut and golden syrup biscuits, crisp at the edges and chewy in the middle, the biscuit Australians bake to remember the Anzacs. Mix 100g rolled oats, 150g plain flour, 80g desiccated coconut and 120g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then stir in 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water so it foams. Pour into the dry mix and stir well. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays, leaving room to spread, and bake at 170C for 12 to 14 minutes until golden. Cool on the trays to crisp up.
K: Black tea, apple and spice. Told you there was water there.

Hot apple tea brewed with dried apple, cinnamon and cloves, sweetened with a little honey and served in small glasses with lemon. Simmer 1L water with 2 diced apples, 60g dried apple, 2 cinnamon sticks and 4 cloves for 15 minutes. Take off the heat, add 2 black tea bags and steep 3 minutes. Strain, stir in 2 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon. Pour into small heatproof glasses and serve hot with a thin apple slice.

veg.n: Major Hasan's chickpea and haloumi kofte
veg.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Mash the chickpeas and mix with the haloumi, grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, cumin, sumac, paprika, half the chopped parsley, breadcrumbs and egg. Chill for 15 minutes.
Shape into 12 long kofte.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, turning, until crisp all over.
Mix the yoghurt with the last crushed garlic clove.
Toss the diced tomatoes and sliced red onion with the rest of the parsley and the lemon juice.
Melt the butter with the chilli flakes.
Serve on warm flatbread with the yoghurt, salad and chilli butter.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Brown the chicken in the butter, add the onion and spices and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice and currants, pour in the stock, cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender.
Rest off the heat, covered, then fluff and finish with toasted almonds and dill.
